Vendored third-party libraries
==============================

These files are vendored (committed to this repository) rather than loaded
from a CDN, so that the invoice tool keeps working if a third-party host is
unreachable and so the site keeps its zero-external-dependency property.

Do not edit these files. To update, re-download the pinned version.


html2canvas.min.js
------------------
Version : 1.4.1
Source  : https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/html2canvas@1.4.1/dist/html2canvas.min.js
Size    : 198689 bytes
SHA-256 : e87e550794322e574a1fda0c1549a3c70dae5a93d9113417a429016838eab8cb
License : MIT
Copyright (c) 2022 Niklas von Hertzen <https://hertzen.com>


jspdf.umd.min.js
----------------
Version : 2.5.1
Source  : https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jspdf@2.5.1/dist/jspdf.umd.min.js
Size    : 364463 bytes
SHA-256 : 98ccf17aa10c20bb1301762618fcc9b6ab3a4e7f26b6071d64d0b41154df3875
License : MIT
Copyright (c) 2010-2021 James Hall and contributors, 2015-2021 yWorks GmbH


Both are used only by invoice.html, and only when the "Download PDF" button
is clicked. They are lazy-loaded on demand so that users who only print never
download them.
